name: Luau
description: API for creating and running isolated Luau environments.

functions.name: setSandboxGlobals
functions.description: Sets the global environment for a sandbox.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: The sandbox to set the globals for.

functions.name: getScriptPath
functions.description: Gets the path of the current caller, or alternatively, the path of the caller referenced by the level.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The level of the caller to get the path of.

functions.name: getScriptDirectory
functions.description: Gets the directory of the current caller, or alternatively, the directory of the caller referenced by the level.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The level of the caller to get the directory of.

functions.name: run
functions.description: Runs a script in a sandbox. The given path is used when resolving relative file paths, such as when calling `Filesystem.toAbsolutePath`.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: The sandbox to run the script in. The executed script has access to the sandbox using the `THIS_SANDBOX` global.

parameters.name: scriptPath
parameters.description: The path to use for the script. The executed script has access to the path using the `SCRIPT_PATH` global.

parameters.name: sourceCode
parameters.description: The source code of the script.

functions.name: runFile
functions.description: Runs a script file in a sandbox.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: The sandbox to run the script in.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to the script file.

functions.name: createRequire
functions.description: Creates a function which runs each required module in a sandbox and caches the result.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: The sandbox to run the required modules in.

returns.name: module
returns.description: The return value of the executed file.
